# onetsolutions_ssh_key (Data Source)

Looks up an SSH key of a project by `id` or by `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_ssh_key" "deploy" {
  name = "deploy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The UUID of the key. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `name` (String) The name of the key. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the key was registered (RFC 3339).
- `fingerprint` (String) The SHA256 fingerprint of the key.
- `public_key` (String) The public key in OpenSSH format.
